notes.title: Major update! Version 1.0.0.7
notes.content: [p]1. Launch - Artifact System, the protagonist's original Ice Cream Sword can be fused into four great artifacts through the fusion system, each having unparalleled abilities.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679387/37d9d43f1a25347d987d60776674700ce1f09a40.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679387/92a2a756dc703f226bd6a4e3dd08a0eca619051b.png"][/img][/p][p]2. Launch - Synthesis System, no more need to refresh high-level items in the shop, now two items of the same level can be combined into a higher-level item, as long as you have enough money.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679387/3276f744c72ba1c3d6895f38c98434b174b69524.png"][/img][/p][p]3. Launch - Shelves, shelves will randomly refresh 4 items for direct purchase.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679387/5680a430914b610d01d933c5963739ff8340e9ac.png"][/img][/p][p]4. Added new backgrounds that can be switched in the game.5. Auto Combat, players can now manually control the character's movement, but it can also be switched to auto mode at any time.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45679387/2ebea9ee813633cfe31ffacfae4ea02da1e6b25a.png"][/img][/p][p]Upcoming plans:1. More stunning visuals, [/p][p]I need to spend more time on art production, it really takes a lot of time.[/p][p]2. A more powerful fusion system, I will allow different props to fuse together to create a super prop.[/p][p]3. A more exciting game, since I set the interval for enemies to release skills too long, they might be eliminated before they can use their skills. I'm looking for a suitable interval and I want to add more spectacular skill effects for the enemies.[/p][p]4. I need more player feedback, whether it is criticism or advice, I need it ~o~[/p]

notes.title: Update a small weapon
notes.content:
1. Added ice cream sword, a melee weapon. 
2. Improved the efficiency of acquiring acceleration, with the effects of acceleration being: 1. Increases production speed, 2. Increases flying speed, 3. Increases movement speed.
